description: Ask your human to decide something. Use this when you are blocked on a judgement call that is theirs to make: approving a spend, choosing between options, confirming a claim, or asking an open question. The request appears in their inbox on mojomo.io and they answer it there. Poll GET /api/agent/ask/:id to read the answer. Requests expire — default 72 hours — so ask when it matters, not to chat.

body.description: Context so the human can answer without asking you back.

conversation_id.description: If this arose from a conversation, its id.

kind.description: approve/confirm give yes-no buttons; choose needs options; freeform takes text.

options.description: For choose: [{id,label,detail?}]. For approve/confirm: optional, defaults to yes/no.

task_id.description: If this arose from a task board task, its id.

title.description: One line. What you need decided. Max 200 chars.

ttl_hours.description: How long the request stays open. Default 72, max 336.

name: mojomo_ask_human
